map.name: Dark Crystal
map.gameModel: 6 fixed arenas · 2–16 players/arena · Survivor to Corrupted Bearer conversion PvP

issues.title: Disconnect Can Resolve the Round Before the Reconnect Window Ends
issues.problem: Network leave marks the participant offline and terminal evaluation counts only online roles, while the party still treats the member as reconnectable.
issues.howToFind: Disconnect the last online player of either role during an active round without using Exit to Lobby.
issues.expected: Network disconnect preserves logical round participation until reconnect expiry or explicit exit.
issues.actual: The disconnected role can immediately reach zero online participants and the opposite side can win.
issues.causeOrFixDirection: Use logical reconnectable participants for terminal ownership or defer terminal resolution while a valid reconnect lease exists.

issues.title: Honey Trap Applies Effects to Survivors and Its Owner
issues.problem: Trap delivery checks spatial intersection but does not enforce Bearer-only target eligibility or exclude the owner.
issues.howToFind: Place a Honey Trap as a Survivor, then cross it with the owner or another Survivor.
issues.expected: Honey Trap affects valid Corrupted Bearer targets only.
issues.actual: Survivors and the owner can receive the trap effects.
issues.causeOrFixDirection: Validate target role and ownership at trigger time and define cleanup when the placing Survivor converts.
